about: The assessment method as data. Single source of truth for codes, severities, weights, bands, decisions and review states. The site reads it through assets/method.js (generated: python -m tc_core build-js); tc_core reads it directly.

codes.name: Mistranslation
codes.test: The sense differs from the source's (a word's meaning, a changed subject or referent)

codes.name: Grammatical meaning
codes.test: Tense, aspect, mood, modality, number or voice changed

codes.name: Distinction
codes.test: Two source words merged into one target word, or one split into two that diverge

codes.name: Reading closed
codes.test: Settles a reading the source deliberately leaves open (a choice forced by Urdu grammar is not counted)

codes.name: Grammar
codes.test: Agreement, gender, case or syntax error

codes.name: Non-word or spelling
codes.test: Not a word of the target language, or misspelt

codes.name: Ambiguity
codes.test: Allows a reading the source doesn't

codes.name: Register
codes.test: More formal, colloquial, religious or technical than the source

codes.name: Word choice
codes.test: Right basic meaning, wrong connotation or collocation

codes.name: Imagery
codes.test: A metaphor, simile or image altered or weakened

codes.name: Effect
codes.test: Irony, humour, suspense, emphasis or mood the passage is built to produce is lost or altered

codes.name: Interference
codes.test: Source syntax, punctuation or calques showing through (reported as a pattern under Stylistic tendencies)

grades.name: Exemplary
grades.meaning: A faithful literary equivalent. Deviations are rare and slight.

grades.name: Sound
grades.meaning: Reliable throughout. Deviations are mostly minor and do not distort the work.

grades.name: Serviceable
grades.meaning: Conveys the work, but readers meet recurring losses of sense, image or tone.

grades.name: Deficient
grades.meaning: Frequent or serious deviations. Readers receive a distorted version of the work, which cannot be relied on to represent it.

decisions.meaning: A copy-editor can resolve the issues.
The draft is sound, and the same translator can revise it into shape.
The deviations are too many or too deep to revise. The work must be translated afresh.

acknowledgements.Pre-publication: Any translation can be reworked. This decision concerns the submitted draft, not the possibility of a good translation of this work.
acknowledgements.Published: Any translation can be reworked. This grade concerns the published translation as sampled here, not the possibility of a good translation of this work.

tokens.severeSegs: segments with a major or critical deviation
